home.name: Connor Hellebuyck
home.news: Hellebuyck will start vs. Columbus on Monday.

home.name: Jakub Dobes
home.news: After a breakout 2025-26 season that continued with an impressive postseason run, Dobes has struggled early in 2026-27. As a result, the Canadiens have often turned to Jacob Fowler, but Dobes has strung together a couple of solid outings. The 25-year-old Czech goalie is coming off his best performance of the season, saving 26 of 27 shots (.963 SV%) in a 2-1 overtime win over the Carolina Hurricanes. The Canadiens enter Monday's action as -149 home favourites against a low-scoring Los Angeles Kings team that has lost 14 of their first 21 games (7-12-2).

away.name: Devin Cooley
away.news: Cooley will start in Ottawa on Monday.

home.name: Linus Ullmark
home.news: Ullmark missed nearly three weeks with a lower-body injury, but hasn't missed a step since returning, continuing a tremendous start to the 2026-27 season. The 33-year-old Swedish goalie was solid in his most recent outing, saving 19 of 21 shots (.905 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings. Ullmark has allowed two or fewer goals in all but one of 12 games this season (11-1-0). The Senators enter Monday's contest as significant -247 home favourites against a Calgary Flames team that is 3-1-1 in their past five games.

home.name: Stuart Skinner
home.news: Skinner has had an inconsistent first season with Winnipeg, but has done enough on most nights to give his team a fighting chance. In his most recent game, Skinner allowed four goals on 33 shots (.879 SV%), which was enough to help the Jets secure a point in a 5-4 shootout loss to the Vegas Golden Knights. The 28-year-old goalie has a 4-1-1 record in his last seven appearances with a 3.27 GAA and .876 SV%. The Jets enter Monday's game as slight +100 home underdogs against a Utah Mammoth team coming off a 3-2 win over the Anaheim Ducks.
